offering_description.value: Develops and sells a prescription cancer drug for HER2-positive breast cancer, marketed in the US and licensed to partners abroad. Sells tablets through specialty pharmacies and distributors to oncology practices and hospitals.

customer_segment.value: B2B: specialty pharmacies, wholesalers, hospitals and oncology practices

revenue_model.value: product sales: prescription drug sold to pharmacies and distributors; licensing or royalties: license payments and royalties from ex-US partners

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns and markets its drug, sold to specialty pharmacies and distributors

geography_served.value: global: US direct sales, ex-US markets served through licensed partners

specialization.value: niche specialist: one oncology drug franchise focused on breast cancer

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: specialty pharmacies and wholesalers; partners / resellers: licensed partners selling outside the US

regulatory_exposure.value: high: drug approval and marketing needs FDA approval and oversight by foreign regulators

notes: Describes the main marketed cancer drug; pipeline and partner arrangements may have changed.
